Subject: Renewal true-up and escrow release requirements

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for working with us on the renewal — we ran the final consumption reports and the account is due a small true-up for the April–May window. Finance has requested a single final invoice and the PO to release the funds held in escrow.

Can you confirm the following so we can route this through AP next week?
- Final invoice amount (incl. VAT treatment) that Redwood will issue
- Payee name and wire instructions to reference on our side
- Whether Redwood can provide a VAT reverse-charge statement / tax evidence (we are EU-registered but paying from our US treasury)
- Expected invoice issuance date so we can align the payment run (scheduled for 2027-06-02)

I've attached the PO (Acme_PO_4721.pdf) and included our finance mailbox in CC. If you need a signed MSA I can re-send that as well.

Appreciate a fast confirmation — escrow hold is blocking go-live for the renewed workspace.

Thanks,
Tom Hayes
Head of Procurement, Acme Health

Tom — thanks for the PO and the heads up. Looping in Monica from Billing and Markus from Finance Ops so we can close this out.

Summary / next steps from our side:
- We will prepare a single consolidated final invoice for the renewal true-up and any outstanding usage delta. Monica will issue the invoice once we have the signed PO and MSA on file.
- VAT treatment: we need the buyer VAT registration / tax residency information to apply reverse-charge. Can you confirm Acme's VAT ID and whether the payment is being made from the US treasury or an EU entity?
- Wire instructions / remit: Markus will confirm the exact bank details and the beneficiary name to include on the invoice.
- Target issuance: Monica aims to issue the invoice on 2027-05-24 given receipt of signed docs; payment run on 2027-06-02 should be fine.

Monica / Markus — can you confirm bank wiring details and whether we should mark VAT as 0.00 with reverse-charge note or apply standard VAT?

Thanks — I will hold off issuing until attachments and VAT confirmation are received.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Renewals
